# Talata Basketball

> Basketball club in Copenhagen, Østerbro. Ages 5 to adult, since 2021. Your first session is free.

Talata Basketball is a registered Danish forening (CVR 43599453) on Østerbro in Copenhagen. We run year-round programs for children and adults, teams in the Danish national leagues (DBBF), and camps in the school holidays. Member of DBBF and DGI. About 82 players across the club.

Last updated: 2026-08-10. Season 26/27 started Monday 10 August 2026.

## Programs and training times (season 26/27)

From Monday 24 August 2026 every Strandvejsskolen session runs 30 minutes later than it did earlier in August. The times below are the current ones. Svanemøllehallen is unaffected.

- [Mini, ages 5 to 9](https://talatabasketball.dk/mini): Tuesday + Thursday 15:30-16:30, Strandvejsskolen. 1,800 DKK per half-season.
- [Junior, ages 10 to 12](https://talatabasketball.dk/mini): Tuesday + Thursday 16:30-17:45, Strandvejsskolen. 1,800 DKK per half-season.
- [Sparks, girls only, ages 6 to 14](https://talatabasketball.dk/sparks): Monday 15:30-16:30, Strandvejsskolen. 1,800 DKK per half-season, or 1,200 DKK for Sparks only.
- [Academy U13 and U15, ages 13 to 14](https://talatabasketball.dk/academy): Monday, Thursday, Friday 16:00-18:00, Svanemøllehallen. 3,300 DKK per half-season.
- [Academy U17 and U19, ages 15 to 18](https://talatabasketball.dk/academy): Monday, Thursday, Friday 17:00-19:00, Svanemøllehallen. 3,300 DKK per half-season.

A 12-year-old is Junior at 1,800 DKK, not Academy at 3,300 DKK, unless the family specifically asks for Academy. Competition brackets are a separate thing from these club groups: DBBF brackets go on a player's age on 1 October, so a player who turns 15 in November is still U15 for that season.
- Talata Men, competitive, 18+: Monday + Friday 18:30-20:15, Svanemøllehallen. There is no Wednesday session this season. 2,000 DKK per half-season. Plays DBBF 3. Division Øst.
- Talata Fitness Men, recreational, 18+: same evening slots as Talata Men, no league commitment. 2,000 DKK per half-season.
- U17/U19 Girls: coached by Talata in partnership with Stevnsgade, Tuesday at Kulturhuset Indre By. Enrolment goes through Stevnsgade.

Academy also has a Tuesday off-court day (strength, film, mental training) and Wednesday is a rest day with no session.

Fees are charged per half-season, not per month and not per session. One fee covers every session that group trains. Sibling discounts are available on request, and the club has routes for families where cost is the barrier.

## Coaches and player pathway

- School partnerships: Strandvejsskolen (Mini and Junior, Sionsgade 1, Oesterbro) and ISH, the International School of Hellerup (High School, Thursdays at Svanemoellehallen), run in collaboration with DGI. From 2019 to 2024 head coach Deng Awak was head of the basketball academy at The British School of Vilnius in Lithuania, where he built the programme from the youngest children up to the mid-teens. That programme is not running through Talata today.
- [Coaches](https://talatabasketball.dk/coaches): Deng Awak (head coach and club manager, played pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark, coached in four countries), Jordan Naughton (head of academy, NCAA Division 1 at University of Wyoming, pro with BK Amager), Georg Jespersen (lead coach Mini and Junior, head coach U13 and U9, played youth basketball at Falcon, studying sustainability at Copenhagen Business School), James Young (assistant coach, Chowan University, eight years pro in Denmark).
- [Player placement](https://talatabasketball.dk/placement): Talata's placement service. Routes are high school and prep in the USA and Canada, clubs and academies in Europe including Spain, and college (NCAA, NAIA, JUCO). Representation goes through FIBA licensed agents. The first conversation and the evaluation are free. Two players named publicly: Malthe Mikkelsen joined the Talata Academy for the year and Talata ran the placement process with him to Orangeville Prep (Canada, 2025/26). Johan Lyager Joensen came up through the club from its first season and went to Martins Ferry High School (Ohio, USA, 2026/27); Talata developed him but his family handled that move. Contact coach@talatabasketball.dk. NIL advice from 2027.
- [Player pathway](https://talatabasketball.dk/pathway): Malthe Mikkelsen went to Orangeville Prep in Canada for 2025/26. Johan Lyager Joensen leaves for Martins Ferry High School in Ohio, USA (the Purple Riders), in 2026/27. Marius Wriedt moved from Talata Men to Naestved in the 1. division.

## Joining

The first session is always free, for every program and every age. No experience and no gear needed, just indoor trainers and a water bottle. Balls are provided. New players are welcome all year and the fee is prorated if you join mid-season.

Book a free session: https://talatabasketball.dk/join
Guide to basketball in Copenhagen, including other clubs: https://talatabasketball.dk/basketball-in-copenhagen

## Coaching philosophy

Talata runs a Constraints-Led Approach (CLA), which is ecological dynamics applied to basketball. Skill emerges from the interaction of Task, Environment and Individual. Sessions use small-sided games and game-like problems. No block practice, no form cues, no lines, no over-coaching.

Five pillars: Bamboo Mindset, Repetition Without Repetition, Lag-Free Excellence, Autonomy and Discovery, Representative Integrity.

Full philosophy: https://talatabasketball.dk/philosophy
